title: Shared MLA latent plus Mirror head residual reconstruction codes
hypothesis: A shared rank-128 per-layer MLA latent can replace per-role cached K/V with a 4-coefficient shared residual head code and recover next-token quality at lower per-session KV bytes than independent head residual bases.
physical_object: 6-layer Pythia KV state with 8 heads x K/V x 64 dims, 64-token prefix
mirror_coordinate: Per-token, per-head, per-K/V-role coefficient vector m of rank 4 over one shared residual dictionary per layer
controls: MLA latent + shared residual rank-4 Mirror head codes
MLA latent + same native shared residual dictionary
MLA latent + independent per-head rank-4 residual bases

calibration.PCA: centered joint 1024D K/V vectors per layer; retain rank 128
calibration.residual_dictionary: rank-4 PCA per-layer dictionary fit to residuals across all head/KV roles; per-role token coefficients are m

evaluation.metric: next-token NLL after one query token using reconstructed cached prefix

development.selection_metric: NLL, mean K/V reconstruction error, actual model-state and per-session cache bytes, break-even active sessions, encode/reconstruct/query wall time

paid_objects: FP16 PCA mean and components used by cache encoder/decoder
per-session FP16 MLA latent and residual head coefficients
all shape, dtype and schema metadata

success_gate: Both dev seeds: Mirror NLL delta <=0.05 nat/token versus FP16 and >=0.02 nat/token better than shared MLA rank128; per-session cache bytes <=0.25x FP16; total incremental model-state plus 8 sessions <=0.75x storing 8 FP16 caches; no exact native shared-dictionary alias.
failure_gate: Any quality/bytes miss or exact native shared-residual dictionary alias.
boundaries: PCA encoder is applied to Pythia's already-produced K/V; this screen does not replace/train K/V projections
One query token after a compressed prefix is scored; no full-sequence perplexity claim
CPU reconstruction and operation proxies only; no fused MLA serving kernel claim
Fresh WikiText test split remains sealed after any dev gate miss or native alias
